1.title: Fixed the logo highlight
1.summary: Cleaned a stray artifact out of the mark's highlighter path and kept the tagline.

2.title: Shared header, footer, search and sitemap
2.summary: Every page now gets the same header, footer and breadcrumbs from one script, with site search, a 404 page and a sitemap.

3.title: Studies index and the study template
3.summary: Added the Studies index, a template for new studies, the infobox and the shared study styles.

4.title: Studies moved onto the shared shell
4.summary: The studies index, the template and the Topanga study now use the same header and footer as everything else.

5.title: Field guide opens with 11 entries
5.summary: A wiki-style index of terms with 11 sourced entries, from bioswale to urban heat island.

6.title: Notes section opens with five essays
6.summary: The Notes index and five sourced essays on heat, shade, soil, sidewalks and walking.

7.title: Topanga infobox links into the field guide
7.summary: Terms in the study's infobox now link to their guide entries.

9.title: Sitemap points at the live domain
9.summary: Sitemap and robots.txt now use redrawnvalley.vercel.app.

11.title: Mobile overhaul
11.summary: A bottom tab bar, a contents sheet, tap-to-open footnotes, a collapsible infobox and a study tab bar for phones.

12.title: Hand-drawn icon set and logo
12.summary: A set of hand-drawn icons, a logo mark and a favicon, swapped into the header, tab bar and indexes.

13.title: Sketchbook layer
13.summary: Hand lettering, wobbly borders, pencil offsets, hand-drawn rules, paper grain, tape and a pencil filter, plus a new 404 drawing.

14.title: Hero contour collage
14.summary: A new contour collage behind the home hero, and crisper chart text.

15.title: Simpler icons and logo
15.summary: Redrew the icon set and logo mark with fewer strokes.

16.title: Guide art and study figures redrawn
16.summary: Redrew the guide art, restyled the essay figures and the Topanga study, and added tile banners.

17.title: Icon, mobile and sketch CSS folded together
17.summary: Moved the icon, mobile and sketch styles into two files and fixed a mobile overflow on the 404 page and the grain over sticky UI.

18.title: Seeded motif system
18.summary: Generated art made of grid-filled shapes, drafting tools and plan symbols, seeded per page, with live colour and shape drift.

19.title: Pattern sheet and art cards
19.summary: Added the pattern sheet page and art cards on the home page, fixed contrast on faint text and kept the pencil filter off generated art.

21.title: Study styles cleaned up
21.summary: Moved inline study styles into one stylesheet and removed every !important.

22.title: Mobile pass
22.summary: A taller footer strip, footer clearance above the tab bar, row icon alignment, a figure swipe hint and tweaks to the 404 and pattern sheet.

23.title: Four new motifs
23.summary: Added the pill diagram, section, ledger and crosshatch motifs.

24.title: Topanga drawings use design tokens
24.summary: Replaced inline SVG styles and hex colours with token classes. Geometry and labels did not change.

25.title: Topanga plan and perspective redrawn
25.summary: The plan and perspective drawings now come from a generator driven by the cited dimensions.

26.title: Scroll effects
26.summary: Drawing figures, a layered plan build-up, counters, parallax motif tiles, section rise and a progress line; trees grow with each plan stage.

27.title: New navigation
27.summary: A studies-first header with page flyouts, and a phone tab bar with a More sheet.

29.title: Interaction layer
29.summary: Redraw art on demand, entry previews, a compare slider, plan stages and drawing zoom.

30.title: Looping backgrounds
30.summary: A looping background layer (plan, ridge, contour, tiles) behind the home, guide, studies and notes heroes.

31.title: Loops on footers and study heads
31.summary: Extended the loops to footers, the home Browse header and study heads, with ink tone and fit-top options.

32.title: Type lab opens
32.summary: Six hand-drawn type directions, a font research table and three writing-on animations.

33.title: Wobble type across the site
33.summary: Switched the whole site to Wobble (Shantell Sans).

34.title: Labs become articles
34.summary: Lab notes index, four lab articles, an embed mode for demos and the lab article components.

35.title: Type lab records the Wobble decision
35.summary: The type lab article now explains why Wobble won.

36.title: Margin sketches
36.summary: Large seeded live drawings in the page margins on desktop, and faint ones on phones.

37.title: Page-to-page motion
37.summary: An opening drawing, a tile wipe between pages, handwritten headings, a pencil dab and small interactions, with a motion lab article.

38.title: Search rebuilt
38.summary: A sketched animated dialog with instant, typo-tolerant results, previews and drawn empty states.

39.title: Study 03: Ventura & Topanga corner
39.summary: A new site study of the corner at 22001 Ventura Blvd.

40.title: Study 02: Fallbrook Edge
40.summary: A new site study drawn from City parcel lines.

41.title: Compare slider follows the mouse
41.summary: The before/after slider now tracks the pointer without a click.

42.title: Nav wash and drawn hero buttons
42.summary: A paper-wash header, a calmer hero, drawn hero buttons and a hover compare.

43.title: Opening sheet never blocks clicks
43.summary: The opening animation no longer takes pointer input; it runs 1.5 s with a 3 s failsafe.

44.title: Study rail polish
44.summary: A paper wash behind the study rail, sketches kept off the left edge, items that draw in and an accent tick for the active one; margins now load on the Ventura study.

4c59055.title: Redrawn Valley begins
4c59055.summary: The first version of the site: the Topanga Willows study, the Redrawn Design System write-up and the branch and deploy workflows.
